name: Shinonome
tagline: Tokyo in 22 minutes and Shinagawa in 28 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Rinkai Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 28 minutes to Otemachi, 40 minutes to Shinjuku, 35 minutes to Shibuya and 28 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 3.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.9 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3 m to 4.9 m, a difference of 1.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 6 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 東武ストア 東雲店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 癌研有明病院, about 19 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 昭和医科大学江東豊洲病院, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Rinkai Line.
congestion: Rinkai Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川シーサイド, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. 2LDK ¥270,000 to ¥280,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Tatsumi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shinonome. Tatsumi has the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line, a different set from Shinonome. To Toranomon, for instance, Tatsumi is 13 minutes quicker. On safety, Tatsumi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Ariake is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Shinonome is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Shinonome in a straight line. Ariake has the Yurikamome, a different set from Shinonome. To Shinagawa, for instance, Ariake takes 13 minutes longer. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Ariake comes out ahead.

noiseSources: The 首都高速湾岸線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
東京湾岸道路 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 1 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 13 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Rinkai Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
